skip_reason: Track has real arrangement MIDI content (10 clips, beats 0-1024) but its instrument (a native Ableton DrumGroupDevice, browser path X-Synths#Drum Rack) is missing from the current device chain. A MIDI track with no instrument device (type==1) cannot produce audio; the remaining 6 devices are all audio effects (type==2) with nothing feeding them. Verified this is not a capture bug: real-time arrangement tap and native offline export (Cmd+Shift+R, isolated track render) both correctly captured true digital silence (~-138 dBFS).

evidence.device_type_check: song.tracks[8].devices -> all 6 report type==2 (audio_effect); zero type==1 (instrument) present. Cross-checked device.type semantics against sibling tracks 6/7, which do show type==1 for their Drum Racks, confirming the check is valid.
evidence.backup_diff: Decompressed and diffed 25 auto-saved .als revisions in the project's Backup/ folder (read-only, never touching the live/original file). The DrumGroupDevice is present in every backup up to 'SNTS Style track [2026-04-06 232256].als' and absent from every save from 'SNTS Style track [2026-04-06 234103].als' onward, including the current working file (2026-04-21). This pins the removal to an ~18 minute window on 2026-04-06 (23:22:56-23:41:03). The other 6 devices (same device IDs 10/11/12/14/15/16) are untouched across that same boundary, so this was a clean, single-device deletion, not a broader chain edit.
evidence.implication: Because the instrument has been missing since 2026-04-06, this track is silent in the artist's current real mix too, not only in this isolated bounce.

decision: Confirmed with Anthony (project owner) on 2026-09-11: legitimate skip, do not attempt restoration. No wav produced.
